portInfo.description: Massport’s Flynn Cruiseport Boston sits in the Seaport District and publishes the cruise terminal address as 1 Black Falcon Avenue on its Parking & Driving Directions page. Official parking is at 93 Fargo Street with mandatory advance online reservations and a complimentary shuttle; walking is described as about 0.4 miles or 10 minutes. The main Flynn Cruiseport page places the facility in South Boston’s Seaport with I-90/I-93 and Logan accessibility framing and lists homeport partners including Norwegian, Celebrity and Princess (Princess from 2024). Door WGS84 pins remain null.

politics.visaRequirements: Visa-free for citizens of Visa Waiver Program countries (ESTA required). Others need visa.
politics.entryRequirements: Valid passport required. ESTA required for visa-free countries. Some nationalities need visa.
